entities.name: Battle of the Null Sphere
entities.description: Battle on Dominaria c. -5000 AR during the Thran-Phyrexian War in which Yawgmoth seized the Null Sphere.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: War between the Thran Empire and Yawgmoth's Phyrexians.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Leader of the Phyrexian army who sought the Null Sphere to defeat his attackers.

entities.name: Null Sphere
entities.description: Huge hollow orb in a crater, a monitoring, broadcasting and control center for the Thran Empire's artifacts.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: Empire that built and garrisoned the Null Sphere.

entities.name: Halcyte guards
entities.description: Strike team led by Yawgmoth to take the Sphere.

entities.name: Battle of Megheddon Defile
entities.description: Battle decisively affected by the taking of the Null Sphere.

events.summary: Yawgmoth realizes he needs the Null Sphere's power to defeat his attackers.
events.quote: He would need the power of the Null Sphere

events.summary: Yawgmoth approaches the Sphere on a flying caravel; the garrison's bombards cripple it and the Phyrexians abandon it as it crashes.
events.quote: Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians were forced to abandon the vessel

events.summary: The Phyrexians swarm the garrison and slaughter Thran and Phyrexians alike.
events.quote: Yawgmoth sent his Phyrexians to swarm the garrison.

events.summary: Yawgmoth leads Halcyte guards to take the Sphere, mounting a powerstone equator and loosening it from the ground.
events.quote: Yawgmoth led a strike team of Halcyte guards to take the Sphere itself.

events.summary: The Null Sphere rises from its crater under Yawgmoth's command, with decisive effect on the Battle of Megheddon Defile.
events.quote: starting to float up from the ground into the air

relations.quote: Yawgmoth sent his Phyrexians to swarm the garrison.
